content:
alex: Quick ask — can we try moving the weekly triage from Fri 3:00pm -> Thu 11:00am for the next 4 weeks? I want to test a shorter slot earlier in the day to catch engineers before EOD.

alex: Proposed condensed agenda (30m):
```
- 00–12m: High-priority backlog sweep (owners callouts)
- 12–20m: New bugs & regressions (triage/assign)
- 20–30m: Quick unblock / follow-ups / owners commit next steps
```

alex: Main reasons: fewer calendar conflicts, better overlap with infra on-call, and keeps Friday free for deep work. Thoughts?

maria: Thu 11am works for me most weeks. +1 to shorter agenda. :thumbsup:

jordan: I have a standing product sync Thu 11:15 — would that push the triage to 11:30? 11:30 is also okay for me but prefer not after noon.

samira: I can be flexible this month but worried about rotating owners who are in APAC. Thu 11am might be late for them. Can we add a rotating owner option so APAC folks can nominate an async delegate?

alex: Good catch @samira — yes let's keep owner rotation. Proposal: owners post quick 1-line async updates in the triage thread before the meeting if they can't attend. We'll only call out owners who report blockers.

ton y: (typo) tony: I can take next week's "owners" slot if we move it to Thu. Also +1 for owners posting updates in thread.

maria: If we move, can someone update the calendar invite and include the condensed agenda and the async update expectation?

calendar-bot: Event updated: "Weekly Engineering Triage" moved to Thu 11:00 AM — recurrence: weekly — description updated with condensed agenda and "post owner updates in thread if you can't attend". Link: https://calendar.example.com/event/weekly-triage

jordan: OK, with the calendar update and the async delegate rule I'm onboard. Can we trial for 4 weeks and reassess?

alex: Sounds good — trial for 4 weeks. I'll ping the owners doc and add a tiny checklist: "post 1-line status if absent". Thanks all. :white_check_mark:

samira: Great — can we also add a 1-min pre-read note in the calendar event (top 3 things to check) so folks skim in advance?

alex: Done — added "Top 3 to scan before meeting" to the event description. I'll follow up after 4 weeks with metrics (attendance, avg meeting length, number of async updates).

maria: Thanks alex.

alex: Thanks team — will observe and report back.
